description: format=csv: a byte order mark, the column titles, a row per response; every column
difference: The old line ending was the server platform's; the bridge writes CRLF and quotes a cell holding a comma, a quote or a line break (ADR 0040 point 1). The old sort of the columns was unstable (Submitted and Client Id, neither a question, could come in either order); the bridge keeps the order they were found in.
